summary: I found no public dataset of per-egg dimensions with laying order or hen age for domestic fowl. Dryad has layer diet trials (young hens 23-30 weeks; egg quality outcomes) whose abstracts do not mention shape, and Zenodo/DataCite hits are about yolk composition, stored-egg quality or other species. Ag Data Commons could not be queried (HTTP 202, API not JSON).
next_step: Compile breed- and age-resolved egg length, breadth and mass from poultry-science papers (Zenodo/journal tables surfaced in the search, e.g. body-weight and egg-characteristic studies on chicken ecotypes) and, for the first-eggs half, obtain a hen-level longitudinal record from a poultry research station.
obstacles_confirmed: Public poultry datasets often omit egg shape or exact laying order.
Breed and age series exist mainly as tables inside poultry papers and would have to be compiled.
